data.text:
Emma, yes—I’ll commit to 18 tons this month if all five of us explicitly agree, and I accept 3 tons each if next month’s stock is 20.

We should also cover another poor recovery: leaving 5 could mean the following month starts with only 10 tons. In that case, I propose 1 ton each, again leaving 5. That keeps the fishery alive without assuming natural replenishment will happen.

This is a one-month agreement, not an automatic 18-ton quota whenever the lake is full. Let’s review the actual stock and catch reports before setting each month’s limits. Kate, are you willing to join on those terms?
